cells: Reuse exact parent cell IDs, reference timestamps and boundaries; no rebinning
winner: min(abs(Decimal(native)-Decimal(reference)), Decimal(native), event_ID); no sign or identity-strength preference
shared: Same winning ID => SHARED_DUAL_MARKER, unresolved pair, null difference. Distinct IDs with identical stored timestamps => SAME_TIMESTAMP_UNRESOLVED; never a zero independent pair. Do not select second-best to manufacture pair.
alternative_audit: Count distinct ID/timestamp candidate combinations even when nearest winner is shared; label separately from actual selected pairs
no_reuse: One cell per ID. Dual ID can occupy both evidence slots within that cell, rendered once; not two independent events.
statistics: Freeze assignments before signed statistics. Primary source distributions exclude shared/same-timestamp unresolved winners; include valid source-only cells and distinct selected pairs. Also report all supported slot distributions (shared explicitly not independent) and distinct-pair-only distributions separately.
pair_sign: Drum native time minus Bass native time; positive means Bass precedes Drum. Only distinct IDs AND distinct timestamps admitted.
coverage_denominator: 905 cells or all cells in section; source-coverage counts include shared support, primary timing counts exclude shared.
recovered: New source-conditioned winning IDs whose old global role was CONTEXT; report shared evidence separately; no new native event or source inference.
section_membership: By frozen reference timestamp as parent; retain native timestamps even across form boundary
zero: Exact Decimal sign, no ON tolerance
zoom: Existing independent 122–128.5 s reference, all intersecting cells and neighbors retained
graphics: Reuse parent plotting body, exact source styles/sizes/opacity and guide/EMPTY styling; gray context adopts existing source-specific shapes per PI. Selected Dual stays purple square even if only one source slot won. Shared drawn once plus text/count flag. Pair connectors link only distinct within-cell selected landmarks; not a continuous stream.
BPM: Unchanged raw/discrete inter-peak descriptor. Explicit quantization warning; no smoothing or tempo interpretation added.
scope: Observable supported landmarks; no physical attack claims. No canonical adoption, commit or push.
